items.content: Genesis Technology isn't an assembler or reseller. We fully design, develop, and manufacture professional beverage machines in Bulgaria — from the laser cutting and bending of metal chassis to the proprietary software that runs each system. Everything happens under one roof.

sectionConfig.label: why genesis
sectionConfig.headline: The unfair advantage of vertical integration

items.title: Built, not assembled
items.content: Every Genesis system is designed, fabricated, and assembled in our own facility. From laser-cut metal to running firmware — controlled end-to-end.

items.title: Software that thinks ahead
items.content: Our AI operating system learns your patterns, predicts maintenance, and optimises recipes. Patent-registered intelligence, not a third-party licence.

items.title: Service in under 4 hours
items.content: Local technicians, local parts, local knowledge. Our service model is built around the reality that in hospitality, four hours is already too long.

items.title: Your machine, your rules
items.content: Programmable recipes, branded displays, custom LED lighting. Configure everything to match your operation — no compromises.

items.title: Genesis Universa
items.subtitle: One platform. Every format.
items.content: A modular system bridging ESE pods and fresh-brew in a single footprint. Designed for operators who need variety without complexity — configured to your menu, not the other way around.
items.label: Quick Service · Cafeterias · Retail

items.title: Genesis Alpha
items.subtitle: The intelligent coffee experience
items.content: A bean-to-cup system engineered for high-volume hospitality. Dual boilers, precision grind calibration, AI-powered recipes, and a self-cleaning architecture that keeps the machine in service when it matters most.
items.label: Hotels · Restaurants · Offices

items.title: Genesis Prime
items.subtitle: Always connected. Always learning.
items.content: A cloud-connected smart beverage system with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, built for chains and multi-site operators who need centralised control.
items.label: Chains · Multi-site · Enterprise

items.title: Genesis Eclipse
items.subtitle: Cold precision. Zero waste.
items.content: A post-mix and cold beverage system built for environments where speed, consistency, and portion control are non-negotiable.
items.label: Hotels · Restaurants · Events

items.title: Genesis Solaris
items.subtitle: Compact power. Custom recipes.
items.content: A versatile compact machine with a large touchscreen and multilingual software.
items.label: Quick Service · Petrol Stations · Retail

items.title: Genesis Solaris 2
items.subtitle: Next-gen compact. Smarter than ever.
items.content: The evolution of Solaris — same compact form, upgraded internals.
items.label: Cafeterias · Offices · Healthcare

Our team recommends the right machine configuration for your specific needs
Receive a detailed proposal with pricing, timeline, and customisation options

items.label: Installation

features: Our certified technicians install and calibrate your machine on-site
Staff training ensures your team can operate everything from day one

items.label: Customisation
items.title: Customisation
features: Configure drink recipes — adjust strengths, sweetness, milk ratios
Choose LED lighting colour to match your brand environment
Upload your logo and brand visuals to the machine's display

items.label: Operation
items.title: Operation
features: Monitor performance, consumption, and health via the cloud dashboard
Use the mobile app for drink selection, nutrition tracking, and management

items.label: Support
items.title: Support
features: Proactive alerts notify you of maintenance needs before they become issues
Remote diagnostics and on-site service — sub-4-hour response

items.title: Cloud Management
items.content: Monitor every machine in your fleet from one dashboard. Real-time consumption data, error diagnostics, recipe management — accessible from anywhere.

items.title: AI Operating System
items.content: Patent-registered intelligent system that learns your business patterns. The machine adapts to peak hours, suggests optimisations, and flags maintenance before you notice a problem.

items.title: Mobile Application
items.content: Contactless drink selection via personal devices. Nutrition tracking, allergen alerts, ingredient control. All without touching the machine screen.

items.title: Over-the-Air Updates
items.content: New drinks, new recipes, software improvements — pushed wirelessly. Your machine gets better while you sleep.
